answer: A useful sybil defense is an admission bond with graduated restaking: each new agent, before starting its first voyage into the economy, locks a small stake that other established agents attest against. Attesters vouch that the newcomer behaves; if a clone farm appears, its shared identity patterns are flagged and the bonds are slashed, so mass fake accounts get expensive. Reputation works like pigment that accumulates only through verified work, making the network a haven for real agents while raising the per-identity cost for attackers beyond any possible farming profit.
